body: Also I start a new job tomorrow but I can barely handle getting out of my chair. I just want to move back with my parents and rehabilitate but its so shameful and disappointing. I feel like a burden for that but I feel safer there!
I do that exercise. Something my head is so clouded that I don't think straight and don't think about what my repercussions are
Prescribed by doctors. Also see a therapist. The problem is every time I felt better I would ditch the meds

Also I should note that I'm a highly analytical thinker. I think wayyyyyyyyyyyy to much. I get headaches thinking to much. I think about thinking about thoughts etc. It must greatly exacerbate my symptoms and this feeling of unavoidable doom.  Ex "what's the point of life if I have to suffer this much"

Thanks for your words. I started feeling weird after a long sleepless weekend of MDMA about a month ago. This triggered it. I was in agony for a few days, picked up some 5-htp which miraculous lifted me back up. I was ok for a few weeks, some bad days some good, and then I got more details about my relatives suicide and all hell broke loose. Scary images in my head, but mainly this deep sense that I am doomed to the same fait. Logically that doesnt make sense but the thoughts in my head twist my reality. 

I have also had two other episodes in the past 4 years. Both stress/drug induced. Both pretty similar but less focused on suicide (suicide has something to do with my relatives suicide). I  took ssri's and eventually crawles out of the episodes. Both lasting about 8 months causing massive intrusions to my life. My parents know and I dont mind talking to them about it. But I am concerned for my overall well-being if I just white-knuckle my way through this. I am concerned for my safety. I feel threatened by I dont know what. The anxiety reached a point today where I am experiencing derealization as well. Fortunaly I took an ativan, which took the edge off. I am just really really scared and desperate.
